about: W1, on B23's scheme since I1: the bridge handshake both sides must agree on (helper/src/engines/auth.ts, bridge CaretPageProtocol/Auth.swift). launchSecret is the launcher's 32 bytes; secret is the page key derived from it, HMAC-SHA256(launchSecret, 'caret-page-key'), the raw 32 bytes the hex names. Proofs are lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256; the helper's names its pid.
